name: turboexpander_ideal_nozzle_laval
title: Turbo-expander: ideal nozzle and Laval wheel (exercise)
summary: Steady exercise model of one turbo-expander: an ideal nozzle with total-enthalpy conservation and a throat that can choke, followed by a Laval wheel. The specified power is 5 MW. The model computes the mass flow, the throat area and the wheel diameter.

verification.summary: Compared with the stored solution of R4-Ex2.EES. compare_solution.py: 28 common variables, 17 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 1. Maximum relative difference 2.85e-01 on s_su. The 28 equations are satisfied. eta_laval is 0.8673469388 in both. M_dot is 10.260 kg/s against 9.238; D is 0.71839 m against 0.70601. Inlet enthalpy is 126553 J/kg above EES.
verification.reference: EES stored solution in R4-Ex2.EES (EES X7.458)
verification.notes: 28 common variables. The tool prints 2.85e-01 on s_su; the exact ratio is 0.2848500975169177. The extra CoolSolve name is PI, the built-in in U = PI*D*N, not an unknown.
